'''Samuel Leiter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 North Carolina State Championship]] on 28 April 2001, according to Ivan Kanner's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2195">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-nc-states-oxford-nc-4-28-01d2195/ nc-states-oxford-nc-4-28-01], DeckTech (Ivan "ZippyDaJedi" Kanner, 30 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-nc-states-oxford-nc-4-28-01d2195/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
